canada.title: Alberta government tables bill to adopt redrawn electoral ridings
canada.summary: The NDP says the changes are an attempt to rig the 2027 election, while the UCP says it's about boosting effective representation and that hybrid ridings already exist in Alberta.

canada.title: Ontario tables new law introducing stronger legal protections for victims of intimate image abuse
canada.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford's government tabled a bill Monday that would create a new legal pathway for victims of intimate image abuse to have those images deleted.
canada.outlet: CBC News + CP24 + Global News + CityNews (CP)

canada.title: N.L. premier waiting to hear from Quebec on Churchill River power deal
canada.summary: Quebec Energy Minister Stéphane Paquet said the Churchill River power deal is not set in stone, setting off a series of questions for Premier Tony Wakeham in Newfoundland and Labrador's House of Assembly.

canada.title: Living Sky Wildlife Rehab asks province to reinstate operating licence
canada.summary: Living Sky Wildlife Rehabilitation says it has turned away dozens of animals since losing its licence and wants the province to reverse its decision. The province appears to be moving on without it.

canada.title: Settlement approved in N.S. First Nation class action over non-consensual MRI scans
canada.summary: A $400,000 settlement has been approved in a class action that alleged members of a Nova Scotia First Nation were subjected to MRI scans without their consent.

canada.title: 120-year-old church bell weighing 300 pounds stolen from belfry in rural Manitoba
canada.summary: The case of the stolen church bell has police sounding an alarm — and scratching their heads.

canada.title: Ontario Catholic school teachers vote in favour of strike mandate: union
canada.summary: The union representing 45,000 teachers in Ontario's English Catholic schools says 98 per cent of its members have voted in favour of a strike mandate.
canada.outlet: CBC News + CityNews + CP24 (CP), Ottawa Citizen, Global News

canada.title: Gwich'in Tribal Council sets new date for annual general assembly after postponing twice
canada.summary: The assembly, originally scheduled for August, was first delayed because the council said it needed more time to finalize financial documents. In September, the council delayed the assembly again because it said it couldn’t reach quorum.

canada.title: Moncton's Julie Doiron 'surprised' to land on Pitchfork's top 100 indie rock albums of all time
canada.summary: Moncton's Julie Doiron says she never imagined Broken Girl would make Pitchfork's list of the 100 best indie rock albums of all time. It's No. 43, three decades after she wrote it at the age of 21.

canada.title: Water at 6 N.W.T. schools now safe to drink after repairs due to high lead levels
canada.summary: Six schools located throughout the Northwest Territories now have safe drinking water coming out of water fountains and taps, after the territorial government completed remediation work when water from some of the fixtures exceeded Health Canada lead guidelines.

canada.title: Former N.L. cabinet minister Lloyd Matthews dead at 83
canada.summary: A minister in the cabinets of Clyde Wells and Brian Tobin, Lloyd Matthews, died on Saturday.

canada.title: No complaint received by ombudsman after children allegedly confined in locker
canada.summary: Quebec's ombudsman's office says it won't be able to investigate or issue recommendations until a parent or student files a complaint.

canada.title: Ontario’s medical regulator pauses safer supply drug changes after legal challenge
canada.summary: Ontario’s medical regulator is hitting pause on implementing a host of changes to the ways doctors prescribe safer supply drugs after it was served with a legal challenge.

canada.title: Homicide team investigating after man, 23, and woman, 24, killed in Surrey
canada.summary: A homicide team has been called to Surrey, B.C., where a man and a woman were shot and killed Sunday night.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News, Vancouver Sun

canada.title: Nova Scotia school support workers reject tentative deal, union weighs next steps
canada.summary: The union representing school support workers in Nova Scotia said its members have rejected a tentative agreement with the employer.

canada.title: 4 people charged with manslaughter after death of 33-year-old in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Three men and one female teenager are facing manslaughter charges in relation to the death of Kyle Andrew Devon Jerome in Winnipeg.

canada.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
canada.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

canada.title: Coroner's inquest into Alberta woman's death in Kenora, Ont., slated to start on Monday
canada.summary: A coroner’s inquest into the death of a 29-year-old Alberta woman at Lake of the Woods District Hospital (LWDH) in Kenora, Ont., is expected to start later Monday morning. Here is what we know about the upcoming proceedings.

lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

A former United States Ambassador to Canada says he’s optimistic a bilateral deal between the two nations is looming but cautioned Canadians not to expect a Democrat-controlled Congress to reign in President Donald Trump’s tariffs, The Canadian Press reports.
St. John’s woman once again charged with fraud — this time involving Elizabeth Fry Society, CBC News reports.
Nvidia led another sell-off in technology stocks and helped drag the U.S. market lower, The Associated Press reports.
With the busiest travel season ahead, how likely is it that another FAA ground stop happens?, The Canadian Press reports.
A Massachusetts judge on Monday scheduled Lindsay Clancy’s retrial for late March after prosecutors signaled that — at least for now — they intend to prosecute, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
